{"id": "8:38/q28", "question": "What unrelated name-truncation examples occur in the collected grammatical material?", "turns_on": "", "positions": [{"id": "8:38/q28/p1", "position": "Proper names can be shortened in address, with the remaining form adjusted or preserved according to morphology and usage.", "reasons": "Sibawayh illustrates ta marbuta deletion with عرقوة, قمحدوة, رعوم, قطوان, طفاوة, معاوية and حيوة; al-Ajjaj's verse supports يا معا.
